about_pullquote: I started out because I hated waiting a week for a five-minute job.
about_para_1: Leeds Handyman Services was founded in 2006 on a simple idea: homeowners shouldn't have to book three trades and wait three weeks for small repairs. Based in Yeadon, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, fixing the job right, and charging a fair fixed price. Over eighteen years we've completed more than 2,000 jobs across Leeds — from emergency plumbing to carpentry — and we've never had a customer wait more than two hours.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we don't oversell, and we treat your home with respect. We don't employ a call centre or pass jobs to contractors — you get the same experienced handyperson every time. Repeat work makes up 40% of our business, and we're insured, vetted, and CHAS-registered for complete peace of mind.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator before Christmas. Dave came out the same evening and had it sorted in 45 minutes. Fair price, no mess, brilliant bloke. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Needed some shelves put up properly in the kitchen. Came out next morning, found the studs, fitted them level and secure. Finished in an hour and left the place clean. Top job.
reviews.author: James H.

reviews.text: Called about a stuck door at half eight in the morning — they were here by ten. Rehung it, sorted the hinges, and it moves like new. No faffing about. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Sandra K.
